title: Comparative vs. Superlative
examples: My sister is two years younger than me.
The slowest animals in the world are sloths.
Spring is the most beautiful season of the year.
Math is more important to me than biology.
Hiba is the best doctor in our city.
That test was more difficult than the previous one.
Tamir has got the longest message from his parents.
English is easier for me than Chinese.
My phone is more expensive than my brother's phone.
Last winter was the coldest winter in our country.
Can you name the highest building in the world?
